unit.why: Praise of R. Zvi Hirsh of Zhidachov in two parts: a quotation from an approbation calling him a disciple of Rashbi, and a saying that his master's introductions suffice for a new commentary on the Torah. There is no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: the closing words 'ממדריגותיו הנוראים' appear to be a heading introducing the next division
